Pose - Casual Lean.description:
🕴️ Pose: Casual Lean
Leaning against a wall or surface — relaxed, unhurried, and projecting ease.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Casual Lean.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, shift the torso and one shoulder into a relaxed lean. Use a wall or vertical surface only when supported by the selected scene; otherwise imply the weight shift without adding a prop. Female: weight into one hip, the shoulder line tipping with it. Male: weight into one shoulder, the frame staying square. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own lean.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
